events.verdict: Achiuwa (NYK) moves alongside Maxey's (PHI) path in a legal guarding position before cleanly blocking the driving shot attempt. The body contact before the blocked shot is incidental.
Edwards (PHI) contests Anunoby's (NYK) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Anunoby (NYK) grazes George's (PHI) arm during the driving shot attempt and the contact is marginal.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Achiuwa (NYK) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Hart's (NYK) momentum carries him into his teammate Anunoby (NYK), causing the illegal contact with Oubre Jr. (PHI) during the loose ball.
Anunoby (NYK) briefly places his hands on Maxey (PHI) without extension and the marginal contact does not affect his shot attempt.
Brunson (NYK) stops short to enter his shooting motion and the body contact by Edwards (PHI) is marginal.
Brunson (NYK) does not beat Maxey (PHI) to the spot and initiates body contact that affects Maxey's SQBR.
Edwards (PHI) commits a take foul on Brunson (NYK).
Maxey (PHI) deflects the ball away from Brunson (NYK) and any contact that occurs is incidental.
Achiuwa (NYK) blocks Maxey's (PHI) shot attempt after the ball makes contact with the backboard and has a chance to score.
Edwards (PHI) legally contests Anunoby's (NYK) jump shot attempt.
